thread:
neha: Kicking off prod deploy v3.4.1 now. Main change is dynamic_routing + KV-cache tweak. Rolling feature flag 'dynamic_routing' with temporal pin strategy: 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 30m windows. Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/v3.4.1 . @dylan you're on metrics, @cj on canary ops.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: release/v3.4.1 ; canaries: shard-a, shard-b ; started at 1766001234.

dylan: copy. watching p50/p95, error-rate, and model mem pressure. Alerts set: p95 > 350ms, request_error_rate delta > 0.3%.

cj: On call for rollback/pinning. If we need to pin model version, command is:
```
ffctl pin dynamic_routing --model v11 --cohort all
```
I'll be ready to run that if memory or GC goes bad.

samir: Small ask: can we timelock unpin for 10m so a transient blip doesn't auto-unpin? i.e. hold any manual pin for 10m before auto-lift. Suggest `timelock 10m`.

maya: Enabling 100% trace sampling for requests hitting the flag for the next 40m so we can triage root cause quickly.

deploy-bot: Canary result: dynamic_routing @5% — canaries OK (latency within baseline) after 7m. Rolling to 20% now.

neha: Ramping to 20% — do not escalate unless alerts fire.

dylan: Seeing p95 increase +40ms (from 280 -> 320ms) and small error bump +0.12%. Still under thresholds. CPU on gpu-pool-3 up ~9%.

cj: Noted. I'll keep an eye on GPU memory and KV cache fill. If heap usage > 78% on any node I'll pin.

deploy-bot: Ramped to 20% at 1766002100. Next window target 50% at ~1766003900.

dylan: At 20% now, telemetry shows eu-west-2 cohort error rate creeping to 0.9% (baseline 0.2%). US cohorts unchanged.

neha: Hold on further ramp for eu-west-2. We will continue ramp for other regions.

cj: Performing targeted cohort action:
```
# set eu-west-2 to 0% for dynamic_routing
ffctl set dynamic_routing --cohort eu-west-2 --percent 0 --actor cj
```

deploy-bot: Action received: ffctl set dynamic_routing --cohort eu-west-2 --percent 0 ; applied to cohort eu-west-2.

dylan: Confirming metrics after targeted rollback: eu-west-2 error rate back to 0.25% within 4 minutes, p95 returned to baseline. US-east & APAC continue at 20%.

neha: Good catch. We'll keep eu-west-2 pinned off until follow-up. Please open a bug with traces and attach the trace ids @maya.

samir: I'll create the ticket and include a short repro plan. Also going to schedule a 1hr debug session tomorrow.

maya: Uploaded traces: trace_ids: tr-63b9, tr-63c0. Added sampling notes and spans where routing latency spikes.

cj: For safety, adding a temporal pin command to prevent immediate re-enable via automation:
```
ffctl pin dynamic_routing --cohort eu-west-2 --reason "post-rollout hold" --until 1766009967
```
(sets an explicit hold until epoch 1766009967).

neha: Ok. Continue the rest of the rollout to 50% for non-eu cohorts, but maintain an operational hold rule: if any cohort's error > 1% or p95 > 400ms, auto-drain to previous config and notify #incidents.

deploy-bot: Ramping non-eu cohorts to 50% now. Canary shards stable.

dylan: US cohorts at 50% show steady latency. No error spikes. Monitoring for 15m.

neha: Team — summary: dynamic_routing deployed with targeted hold for eu-west-2 due to elevated errors. Action items: samir will file bug + schedule debug, maya will attach traces, cj created a temporal pin, dylan will keep telemetry watch for next 90m. We'll revisit tomorrow in the post-deploy sync. Thanks. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Deploy finished for release/v3.4.1 at 1766004567. All other post-deploy hooks executed.
